name: Tocantins
summary: A diagonal white band from lower hoist to upper fly with a yellow-gold sun, between blue at the upper hoist and gold at the lower fly.
origin: Tocantins was created from northern Goiás on 1 January 1989. Its flag was adopted by State Law 94/89 on 17 November 1989.

colors.name: Gold
colors.meaning: Gold and mineral wealth; the sun.

symbols.name: Sun
symbols.meaning: A land where the sun rises for everyone.

facts: Palmas, its capital, was founded in 1989.
clues: A sun on a white diagonal band between blue and gold.
